changes: New iCloud Cleanup tool (Mac): finds files in iCloud that haven't been modified in 1–10 years (5 by default), lists them biggest-first with their dates, and lets you tick exactly which to delete.
Every tool now has an "Include iCloud" option — iCloud Drive, app data, and synced Desktop & Documents can each be switched on separately. Everything stays off until you tick it.
Quick Clean can free the local copy of old iCloud downloads while keeping the files safely in iCloud.

Deleting from iCloud always needs an extra confirmation. Files that are on your Mac can be undone; cloud-only files go to the Trash (and iCloud.com Recently Deleted for 30 days) so they're never lost for good by accident.
Mac download: Aurum Cleaner for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) is now available as a DMG alongside the Windows installer.
Includes everything from 1.1.0: Mac Quick Clean, Undo History, and iCloud safeguards.
Aurum Cleaner now runs on macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) — download the DMG, drag it to Applications, done.
New Undo History on Mac: everything Aurum removes is kept so you can restore it with one click, or free the space for good whenever you like.

Mac Quick Clean targets only junk — app caches, logs, crash reports, old iPhone/iPad updates, leftover macOS installers, Xcode build data. Messages, Mail, Calendar, Photos and Notes are never touched.
iCloud stays in your hands: it's skipped by default, and deleting anything from iCloud asks for an extra confirmation.
Aurum Cleaner is now out of beta — first stable 1.0 release.
General polish and stability improvements across Quick Clean, Disk Analyzer, Large Files, Duplicates, and Claude Cleanup.
Disk Analyzer now lets you select/deselect files before deleting, just like Large Files and Duplicates — nothing is removed without you picking it first.
New app icon and title bar mark.

Quick Clean, Claude Cleanup, Disk Analyzer, Large Files, and Duplicates now keep scanning or deleting in the background if you switch to another page, instead of stopping — a toast in the top-right lets you know when a job finishes while you're away.
The version number in Settings now always matches the running app version.
Fixed dropdown menus (like the drive picker) rendering unreadable white-on-white text.
Added a drive picker to Disk Analyzer, Large Files, and Duplicates so you can jump straight to any drive, not just C:\Users.
Added automatic updates — Aurum Cleaner now checks for new versions on launch, downloads them in the background, and installs on restart.
Added this What's New screen, shown once after every update.
Initial release: Dashboard, Quick Clean, Disk Analyzer, Large Files, Duplicates, and Claude Cleanup.
